jardine-matheson.name: Jardine Matheson
jardine-matheson.description: Jardine Matheson Holdings Limited is a multinational conglomerate based in Hong Kong, domiciled in Bermuda, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. It also has secondary listings on the Singapore Exchange and Bermuda Stock Exchange.

johnson-controls.name: Johnson Controls
johnson-controls.description: Johnson Controls International plc is an American multinational conglomerate headquartered in Cork, Ireland. It produces fire, HVAC, and security equipment for buildings and employed 105,000 people across six continents as of 2019. The company was listed in the Fortune Global 500 in 2017.

japan-tobacco.name: Japan Tobacco
japan-tobacco.description: Japan Tobacco Inc. is a Japanese diversified tobacco company and parent to Japan Tobacco International, one of the largest global tobacco manufacturers. Established in 1985, it also operates in pharmaceuticals and food and beverage sectors, acquiring food manufacturer Katokichi in 2008.

jd-com.name: JD.com
jd-com.description: JD.com, Inc., also known as Jingdong Group, is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in e-commerce, retail, internet, and technology. Headquartered in Beijing, it is one of China's largest online retailers and competes with Alibaba's Tmall. Its business spans retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, industrials, property management, private label, insurance, and international business.

jfe-holdings.name: JFE Holdings
jfe-holdings.description: JFE Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese corporation headquartered in Tokyo, formed in 2002 by the merger of NKK and Kawasaki Steel Corporation. It owns JFE Steel, JFE Engineering, and Japan Marine United. The company is part of the iron and steel industry.

jacobs-engineering-group.name: Jacobs Engineering Group
jacobs-engineering-group.description: Jacobs Solutions Inc. is an American international technical professional services firm based in Dallas. It offers engineering, technical, professional, construction, scientific, and specialty consulting services globally. The company has been ranked No. 1 on Engineering News-Record's Top 500 Design Firms for multiple years.

j-b-hunt.name: J. B. Hunt
j-b-hunt.description: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. is an American transportation and logistics company based in Lowell, Arkansas. Founded in 1961, it operates semi-trailer trucks providing transportation services across the US, Canada, and Mexico.

jollibee-group.name: Jollibee Group
jollibee-group.description: Jollibee Foods Corporation, known as Jollibee Group, is a Philippine multinational company headquartered in Pasig, Metro Manila. It owns the fast food brand Jollibee. The company operates in the fast food industry.

jastrzebska-spoka-weglowa.name: Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa
jastrzebska-spoka-weglowa.description: Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa S.A. is a large coal mining company based in Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland. It produces around 12 million tonnes of coal annually and has proven recoverable reserves of 503.4 million tonnes.

jsl-s-a.name: JSL S.A.
jsl-s-a.description: JSL is a Brazilian conglomerate intermodal logistics company founded in 1956 and headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes, Greater São Paulo. Owned by the Simões family, it operates in supply chain services, cargo and passenger transportation, outsourced fleet management, vehicle commercialization, and car rental.

jetblue-airways.name: JetBlue Airways
jetblue-airways.description: JetBlue Airways Corporation is an American low-cost airline headquartered in Long Island City, Queens, New York City. It operates a point-to-point network with six focus cities including its main hub at JFK Airport, serving destinations across the Americas and Europe.

jeld-wen.name: Jeld-Wen
jeld-wen.description: JELD-WEN is an American company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It operates over 120 manufacturing facilities in 19 countries and designs, produces, and distributes doors, windows, wall systems, and other components for residential and non-residential buildings.

jvc-kenwood.name: JVC Kenwood
jvc-kenwood.description: JVCKenwood Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics company headquartered in Yokohama, Japan. It was formed in 2008 from the merger of JVC and Kenwood Corporation. The company focuses on car and home electronics, wireless systems, professional broadcast, CCTV, and two-way radio equipment.

jiangling-motors.name: Jiangling Motors
jiangling-motors.description: Jiangling Motors Corporation Limited (JMC) is a Chinese automobile manufacturer. Its largest shareholder is Jiangling Investment, which is controlled equally by the state-owned enterprises Changan and Jiangling Motors Corporation Group.

jcdecaux.name: JCDecaux
jcdecaux.description: JCDecaux SE is a French multinational corporation specializing in outdoor advertising. Headquartered in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France, it is the largest company in its sector worldwide with advertisements on bus stops and airports.

juniper-networks.name: Juniper Networks
juniper-networks.description: Juniper Networks, Inc. was an American multinational corporation headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It developed and marketed networking products including routers, switches, network management software, and network security products.

jyske-bank.name: Jyske Bank
jyske-bank.description: Jyske Bank A/S is the third largest Danish bank by market share. It operates in Denmark and provides financial services.

jumia.name: Jumià
jumia.description: Jumia is an African marketplace, logistics, and payment service operating across the continent. It partners with over 100,000 sellers and is Africa's largest online marketplace with millions of monthly visitors.

jensen-group.name: Jensen-Group
jensen-group.description: Jensen-Group NV is a Belgium-based international company that manufactures machines for the heavy-duty laundry industry. It is known for its specialization in laundry machinery. The company operates internationally from its base in Belgium.

jamnica.name: Jamnica
jamnica.description: Jamnica plus LLC is a Croatian company producing carbonated mineral water, bottled waters, and soft drinks. Founded in 1828, it operates as part of the Beverages Group within the Fortenova Group.

janus-capital-group.name: Janus Capital Group
janus-capital-group.description: Janus Capital Group, Inc. was an American publicly owned investment firm headquartered in Denver, Colorado, founded in 1969. It had offices worldwide and was part of the S&P MidCap 400 Index.

josef-manner-comp-ag.name: Josef Manner & Comp AG
josef-manner-comp-ag.description: Josef Manner & Comp AG is an Austrian conglomerate founded in 1890 that produces a wide range of confectionery products. Its Manner line includes wafers, long-life confectionery, chocolate-based products, sweets, cocoa, and seasonal items.

jeudan.name: Jeudan
jeudan.description: Jeudan is the largest listed real estate company in Denmark and the largest private real estate investment company in the country. Its activities include property and facility management. The company is headquartered in Prince William Mansion in Copenhagen.

jyp-entertainment.name: JYP Entertainment
jyp-entertainment.description: JYP Entertainment Corporation is a South Korean multinational entertainment and record label conglomerate founded in 1997. It operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management company, concert production company, and music publishing house. The company also runs subsidiary ventures and divisions internationally.

jhsf-participacoes.name: JHSF Participações
jhsf-participacoes.description: JHSF Participações is a Brazilian real estate holding company focusing on high-income segment recurrent income assets like shopping malls, airports, and hotels. It operates in Brazil and internationally, including the United States and Uruguay. The company is known for prioritizing recurrent income assets.

jiangsu-expressway-company.name: Jiangsu Expressway Company
jiangsu-expressway-company.description: Jiangsu Expressway Company Limited is a Chinese enterprise engaged in investment, construction, operation, and management of toll expressways in Jiangsu Province. Its projects include major expressways and the Jiangyin Yangtze River Bridge.

j-front-retailing.name: J. Front Retailing
j-front-retailing.description: J. Front Retailing Co., Ltd. is a major holding company in Japan. It is headquartered in Yaesu, Chūō, Tokyo.

juki.name: Juki
juki.description: Juki Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of industrial and domestic sewing machines and SMT assembly equipment. Headquartered in Tama-shi, Tokyo, it was once the largest industrial sewing machine manufacturer globally.

jeol.name: JEOL
jeol.description: JEOL, Ltd. is a major developer and manufacturer based in Japan, producing electron microscopes, scientific instruments, industrial equipment, and medical equipment.

japan-exchange-group.name: Japan Exchange Group
japan-exchange-group.description: Japan Exchange Group, Inc. is a Japanese financial services company headquartered in Tokyo and Osaka. It operates as a financial instruments exchange holding company regulated by the Financial Services Agency of Japan.

jio-financial.name: Jio Financial
jio-financial.description: Jio Financial Services Limited is an Indian financial services company based in Mumbai. It was originally a subsidiary of Reliance Industries and became an independent entity listed on Indian stock exchanges in August 2023.

jain-irrigation-systems-limited.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited
jain-irrigation-systems-limited.description: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd. is an Indian multinational conglomerate based in Jalgaon, Maharashtra. The company operates in the agriculture industry.

jiangxi-copper-company-limited.name: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited
jiangxi-copper-company-limited.description: Jiangxi Copper Company Limited is the largest integrated copper producer in China, headquartered in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province. It is a key subsidiary of the state-owned Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The company engages in mining, smelting, refining of copper and other non-ferrous metals, along with related trading and financial services.

jack-in-the-box.name: Jack in the Box
jack-in-the-box.description: Jack in the Box, Inc. is an American fast-food restaurant chain founded in 1951 and headquartered in San Diego, California. It primarily serves the West Coast of the U.S. and formerly operated the Qdoba Mexican Grill chain.

jinduicheng-molybdenum.name: Jinduicheng Molybdenum
jinduicheng-molybdenum.description: Jinduicheng Molybdenum Group Mining Corporation is a Chinese company engaged in molybdenum production, sales, and manufacturing. It provides various molybdenum materials including charging materials, metal products, and chemical products. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

jazz-pharmaceuticals.name: Jazz Pharmaceuticals
jazz-pharmaceuticals.description: Jazz Pharmaceuticals plc is an American global biopharmaceutical company focused on oncology and neuroscience. Founded in 2003 in California, it is now headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.

jbs-s-a.name: JBS S.A.
jbs-s-a.description: JBS N.V. is a Brazilian multinational and the largest meat processing company worldwide. It produces various meats and by-products and is headquartered in São Paulo and Amsterdam.

j-walter-thompson.name: J. Walter Thompson
j-walter-thompson.description: J. Walter Thompson was an American advertising holding company founded in 1896. It was acquired by WPP plc in 1987 and later merged with other agencies to form new entities.

jive-software.name: Jive Software
jive-software.description: Jive Software is a United States-based provider of communication and collaboration software for business. It operates as part of Aurea Software company.

j-alexander-s.name: J. Alexander's
j-alexander-s.description: J. Alexander's Holdings Inc. is an American restaurant company headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. It operates several casual dining restaurant chains across the United States. The company focuses on food service and hospitality.

j2-global.name: J2 Global
j2-global.description: J2 Global, Inc. was an American technology holding company based in Los Angeles, California. It provided Internet services through two divisions: Business Cloud Services and Digital Media. The company operated in the technology sector.

jones-lang-lasalle.name: Jones Lang LaSalle
jones-lang-lasalle.description: Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated (JLL) is a global real estate services company headquartered in Chicago. It operates in 80 countries and offers investment management services, technology products, and venture capital investments. JLL is ranked 175 on the Fortune 500.

jbg-smith.name: JBG Smith
jbg-smith.description: JBG SMITH Properties is a publicly traded real estate investment trust based in Bethesda, Maryland. The company operates in the real estate sector. It focuses on property investment and management.

jx-nippon-mining-metals.name: JX Nippon Mining & Metals
jx-nippon-mining-metals.description: JX Advanced Metals Corporation is a Japanese non-ferrous metal company partially owned by ENEOS Holdings. It engages in resource development, smelting, refining, and recycling, holding about 60% of the global market share in sputtering targets used in semiconductor manufacturing.

johnson-outdoors.name: Johnson Outdoors
johnson-outdoors.description: Johnson Outdoors Inc. produces outdoor recreational products including watercraft, diving equipment, camping gear, and outdoor clothing. It operates in 24 locations worldwide and has been run by Helen Johnson-Leipold since 1999. The company is based in the United States.

joyoung.name: Joyoung
joyoung.description: Joyoung Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of home-use soybean milk machines headquartered in Jinan, Shandong. Incorporated in 1994, it was China's largest soybean milk machine company as of 2009 and was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2008.

jinko-solar.name: Jinko Solar
jinko-solar.description: JinkoSolar Holding Co., Ltd. is a solar module manufacturer headquartered in Shanghai, China. It has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2010. Its subsidiary was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's Science and Technology Innovation Board in 2022.

japan-airlines.name: Japan Airlines
japan-airlines.description: Japan Airlines (JAL) is a major Japanese airline headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. Its main hubs include Tokyo's Narita and Haneda airports, with secondary hubs in Osaka. The JAL group includes several domestic feeder services and low-cost carriers.

jabil.name: Jabil
jabil.description: Jabil Inc. is an American multinational manufacturing company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. It designs, engineers, and manufactures electronic circuit board assemblies and systems, providing supply chain services primarily to original equipment manufacturers.

japan-display.name: Japan Display
japan-display.description: Japan Display Inc., commonly called JDI, is a Japanese display technology joint venture. It was formed by merging the small and medium-sized liquid crystal display businesses of Sony, Toshiba, and Hitachi. The company is based in Japan.

janus-henderson.name: Janus Henderson
janus-henderson.description: Janus Henderson is a British-American global asset management group headquartered in London. It offers a variety of financial products to individuals, advisors, and institutional investors worldwide under the Janus Henderson Investors brand.

janome.name: Janome
janome.description: Janome Corporation is a Japanese company that produces sewing machines. It operates manufacturing plants in Japan, Taiwan, and Thailand, serving the global market for sewing equipment.

jamba.name: Jamba
jamba.description: Jamba, formerly Jamba Juice, is an American quick-service restaurant and juice bar chain selling blended fruit and vegetable juices, smoothies, and other food products. Founded in 1990 in California, it operates 850 locations in the US and several countries in Asia and Australia.

jean-coutu.name: Jean Coutu
jean-coutu.description: The Jean Coutu Group (PJC) Inc. is a Canadian pharmacy chain headquartered in Varennes, Quebec. It operates over 400 franchised locations across Quebec, Ontario, and New Brunswick under various banners. At its peak, it was the third-largest distributor and retailer of pharmaceuticals in North America.

jbt-marel.name: JBT Marel
jbt-marel.description: JBT Marel Corporation, formerly JBT Corporation, is a food processing machinery and automated vehicle company based in Chicago, Illinois. Incorporated in 2008 after FMC Technologies divested its non-energy businesses, it traces its origins to a company founded in 1884 by John Bean in California.

jdsu.name: JDSU
jdsu.description: JDS Uniphase Corporation was an American company headquartered in Milpitas, California, that designed and manufactured products for optical communications networks and test equipment. In 2015, it split into two companies: Viavi Solutions and Lumentum Holdings.

jefferies-company.name: Jefferies & Company
jefferies-company.description: Jefferies Group LLC is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in New York City. It provides capital markets and financial advisory services, institutional brokerage, securities research, wealth management, and asset management.

jb-hi-fi.name: JB Hi-Fi
jb-hi-fi.description: JB Hi-Fi Limited is an Australian consumer electronics retail company headquartered in Southbank, Melbourne, Victoria. It is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

jakks-pacific.name: Jakks Pacific
jakks-pacific.description: Jakks Pacific, Inc. is an American toy manufacturer founded in January 1995. The company is known for producing licensed action figures, playsets, dolls, plush toys, dress-up sets, and Plug-n-Play Television Game Consoles popularized in the 2000s. It operates in the consumer products industry.

jeju-air.name: Jeju Air
jeju-air.description: Jeju Air Co., Ltd. is the first and largest low-cost airline in South Korea. Named after Jeju Island, it is headquartered in Jeju City with its main base at Jeju International Airport. The airline was a founding member of the Value Alliance.

johnson-matthey.name: Johnson Matthey
johnson-matthey.description: Johnson Matthey plc is a British multinational speciality chemicals and sustainable technologies company headquartered in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

jgc-holdings-corporation.name: JGC Holdings Corporation
jgc-holdings-corporation.description: JGC Holdings Corporation is a global engineering company headquartered in Yokohama, Japan. It was formerly known as JGC Corporation and before that as Japan Gasoline Co.

jac-group.name: JAC Group
jac-group.description: JAC Group is a Chinese manufacturer of automobiles and commercial vehicles. The company is based in Hefei, China, and operates in the automotive industry.

jiangsu-sainty-corporation-limited.name: Jiangsu Sainty Corporation Limited
jiangsu-sainty-corporation-limited.description: Jiangsu Sainty Corporation Limited is a Chinese listed company based in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. The company is involved in exporting clothes overseas.

joby-aviation.name: Joby Aviation
joby-aviation.description: Joby Aviation, Inc. is an American aviation company developing an electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft intended for air taxi services. It is headquartered in Santa Cruz, California, with additional offices in San Carlos and Marina, California, as well as Munich, Germany.

judo-bank.name: Judo Bank
judo-bank.description: Judo Bank is an Australian neobank that focuses on lending to small and medium-sized enterprises. It also offers personal term deposit products to consumers.

jasic-technology.name: Jasic Technology
jasic-technology.description: Jasic Technology Company Ltd. is a Chinese corporation headquartered in Pingshan New District, Shenzhen, Guangdong province. The company operates out of China but no specific industry is mentioned in the summary.

jsw-steel-ltd.name: JSW Steel Ltd
jsw-steel-ltd.description: JSW Steel Limited is an Indian multinational steel company based in Mumbai. It is the flagship company of the JSW Group and operates in the iron and steel industry.

j-j-snack-foods.name: J & J Snack Foods
j-j-snack-foods.description: J&J Snack Foods Corp. is an American manufacturer, marketer, and distributor of snack foods and frozen beverages. Headquartered in Mt. Laurel, New Jersey, it operates over 175 facilities across the US, Mexico, and Canada.

jack-henry-associates.name: Jack Henry & Associates
jack-henry-associates.description: Jack Henry & Associates is an American financial technology company providing technology solutions and payment processing services to community and regional banks and credit unions. It serves about 7,200 financial institutions and offers products through various cloud and on-premises environments.

james-hardie.name: James Hardie
james-hardie.description: James Hardie Industries plc is a global building materials company headquartered in Ireland. It is the largest global manufacturer of fibre cement products and is cross-listed on the Australian and New York Stock Exchanges. Its management team is based in Chicago, Illinois, United States.

jarden.name: Jarden
jarden.description: Jarden was an American consumer products company formed from Ball Corporation's canning business. It became a conglomerate of consumer brands, especially in outdoors and home appliances. Jarden was acquired in 2016 by Newell Rubbermaid, which was renamed Newell Brands.

jetform.name: JetForm
jetform.description: JetForm Corporation was a Canadian software manufacturer based in Ottawa, Ontario. It was created by five consultants and produced an electronic form software product named JetForm.

jidong-cement.name: Jidong Cement
jidong-cement.description: Tangshan Jidong Cement Co., Ltd. is a Chinese cement manufacturer ranked as the 6th largest globally by 2011 data. It is part of the Jidong Development Group, which also has interests in machinery, real estate, and other construction materials.

jilin-aodong-medicine.name: Jilin Aodong Medicine
jilin-aodong-medicine.description: Jilin Aodong Medicine Industry Group Company Limited is a state-owned enterprise in Dunhua, Jilin, China. It manufactures and sells Chinese patent drugs and pharmaceutical packaging products, and is involved in toll collection and road engineering construction. It was established in 1993 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 1996.

jinchuan-group.name: Jinchuan Group
jinchuan-group.description: Jinchuan Group Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese mining company headquartered in Jinchang, Gansu Province. It is a state-owned enterprise and a leading global producer of nickel and cobalt, also producing other metals. The company operates in over 30 countries and ranked on several Fortune lists in 2024.

jizhong-energy.name: Jizhong Energy
jizhong-energy.description: Jizhong Energy Group Company Limited is a state-owned coal mining company based in Hebei, China. It is one of the seven largest coal companies in China and the country's second-largest metallurgical coal miner after Shanxi Coking Coal Group.

johannesburg-stock-exchange.name: Johannesburg Stock Exchange
johannesburg-stock-exchange.description: The JSE Limited is the largest stock exchange in Africa by market capitalization, located in Sandton, Gauteng, South Africa since 2000. It serves as a major financial market in the region.

jorudan.name: Jorudan
jorudan.description: Jorudan is a Japanese company headquartered in Shinjuku, Tokyo, involved in video game development and publishing since 1991. It also operates a public transport route navigation website.

joyce-boutique.name: Joyce Boutique
joyce-boutique.description: Joyce Boutique Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based fashion retailer operating in Greater China. It franchises fashion, accessories, and cosmetics designer brands under the names JOYCE and mono brand freestanding stores. The company operates 40 points of sale including multi-brand boutiques and beauty store concepts.

jungo-connectivity-ltd.name: Jungo Connectivity Ltd
jungo-connectivity-ltd.description: Jungo Connectivity is an Israeli software company specializing in driver monitoring system software and device driver development. It operates within the software industry in Israel.

justsystems.name: JustSystems
justsystems.description: JustSystems Corporation is a Japanese software development company known for products like the Ichitaro word processor and ATOK Japanese input method. In the 2010s, it shifted focus to correspondence education and enterprise software.

jana-small-finance-bank.name: Jana Small Finance Bank
jana-small-finance-bank.description: Jana Small Finance Bank is a small finance bank headquartered in Bangalore, India. It commenced banking operations on 28 March 2018. It is the fourth-largest small finance bank in India by asset size.

jkn-global-group.name: JKN Global Group
jkn-global-group.description: JKN Global Group Public Company Limited is a Thai multinational conglomerate headquartered in the JKN Empire building in Samut Prakan, Thailand. Founded by Jakkaphong Jakrajutatip, it operates in diverse industries including foods, beverages, cosmetics, entertainment, mass media, and television programming.

jefferies-financial-group.name: Jefferies Financial Group
jefferies-financial-group.description: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. is an American financial services company based in New York City. It is publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is part of the Fortune 1000.

johnson-electric.name: Johnson Electric
johnson-electric.description: Johnson Electric is a China-based company providing motors, actuators, motion subsystems, and related electro-mechanical components for automotive, industrial, and medical applications. It operates manufacturing facilities in 22 countries.

japan-post-bank.name: Japan Post Bank
japan-post-bank.description: Japan Post Bank Co., Ltd. is a Japanese bank headquartered in Tokyo. It is a corporation held by Japan Post Holdings, with the government of Japan holding a majority stake.

john-wood-group-plc.name: John Wood Group plc
john-wood-group-plc.description: John Wood Group Ltd, known as Wood Group, is a British multinational engineering and consulting firm headquartered in Aberdeen, Scotland. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until May 2025 before being acquired by Sidara.

j-c-penney.name: J. C. Penney
j-c-penney.description: JCPenney is an American department store chain founded in 1902 by James Cash Penney. Since 2025, it has been owned by Catalyst Brands, a joint venture between Authentic Brands Group, Brookfield Corporation, and Simon Property Group.

jio-platforms.name: Jio Platforms
jio-platforms.description: Jio Platforms Limited is an Indian multinational technology company headquartered in Mumbai. It is a subsidiary of Reliance Industries and serves as a holding company for India's largest mobile network operator, Jio, along with other digital businesses of Reliance. The company was established in 2019.

j-f-investimentos.name: J&F Investimentos
j-f-investimentos.description: J&F S.A. is a private investment holding company based in São Paulo, Brazil, founded in 1953. It operates in diverse industries such as agribusiness, manufacturing, electricity generation, and real estate. The company is owned by the Batista family.

jren-sparebank.name: Jæren Sparebank
jren-sparebank.description: Jæren Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Bryne, Norway. Its main market is the Rogaland region. The bank operates primarily in financial services within Norway.

jaber-ebne-hayyan-pharmaceutical-company.name: Jaber Ebne Hayyan Pharmaceutical Company
jaber-ebne-hayyan-pharmaceutical-company.description: Jaber Ebne Hayyan Pharmaceutical Company is an Iranian manufacturer and seller of injection and oral antibiotics, ointments, inhalers, nasal sprays, and pearls. Founded in 1960 and based in Tehran, it was formerly known as Squibb Iran before changing its name in 1979. The company is publicly traded on the Tehran Stock Exchange.

james-fisher-sons.name: James Fisher & Sons
james-fisher-sons.description: James Fisher and Sons plc is a British provider of marine engineering services and a major shipowner. The company is based in Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

jinling-hotel.name: Jinling Hotel
jinling-hotel.description: Jinling Hotel Nanjing is a hotel located in Nanjing, China, near the Xinjiekou district. It was the city's first modern hotel managed by Chinese and was the tallest building in China until 1985. The hotel operates various businesses including restaurants, travel agency services, car rental, communications, and advertising.

jos-a-bank-clothiers.name: Jos. A. Bank Clothiers
jos-a-bank-clothiers.description: Jos. A. Bank is an American retailer specializing in men's suits and furnishings. Founded in 1905, it operates over 180 retail locations and three distribution centers. The company is headquartered in Fremont, California, and is part of Tailored Brands.

jirama.name: Jirama
jirama.description: Jirama is a state-owned electric utility and water services company in Madagascar. It provides electric and water services as a public utility.

jubba-airways.name: Jubba Airways
jubba-airways.description: Jubba Airways is a Somali airline operating domestic passenger and cargo flights within Somalia and to destinations in the Middle East.

juba-air-cargo.name: Juba Air Cargo
juba-air-cargo.description: Juba Air Cargo was a cargo airline based in Khartoum, Sudan, established in 1996. It operated domestic cargo services from Khartoum International Airport before ceasing all operations in 2008.

jambojet.name: Jambojet
jambojet.description: Jambojet Limited is a Kenyan low-cost airline that began operations on April 1, 2014. It operates as a subsidiary of Kenya Airways and is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. The airline focuses on providing affordable air travel within the region.

johnsons-air.name: Johnsons Air
johnsons-air.description: Johnsons Air was a Ghanaian airline based at Accra International Airport, founded in 1996 by Farzin Azima. It operated ad hoc cargo services but was blacklisted in Belgium and the EU due to safety concerns before ceasing operations.

jumbo.name: Jumbo
jumbo.description: Jumbo is a Chilean hypermarket chain operating in Chile, Argentina, and Colombia. Founded in 1976 by Horst Paulmann, it is a subsidiary of the Cencosud business consortium, which owns various supermarket and retail brands. Jumbo is a key part of Cencosud's retail operations.

jetsmart.name: JetSmart
jetsmart.description: JetSMART Airlines SpA is a Chilean ultra low-cost carrier controlled by US investment fund Indigo Partners. Its primary base is Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, and it owns JetSmart Argentina. The airline began scheduled operations in July 2017.

jetsmart-argentina.name: JetSmart Argentina
jetsmart-argentina.description: JetSmart Airlines S.A., styled as JetSMART, is an Argentine airline owned by ultra low-cost carrier JetSmart, itself owned by Indigo Partners. It operates a fleet of Airbus A320 family aircraft with a base at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery in Buenos Aires. Its aircraft are registered in Argentina.

jamaica-red-cross.name: Jamaica Red Cross
jamaica-red-cross.description: The Jamaica Red Cross Society is a humanitarian aid agency operating in Jamaica. It provides emergency and relief services within the country.

juhayna-food-industries.name: Juhayna Food Industries
juhayna-food-industries.description: Juhayna Food Industries is an Egyptian food and beverage company established in 1983. It began producing dairy, yogurt, and juice products in 1987 and merged with Juhayna Dairy in 2004 to consolidate operations. The company specializes in milk, dairy products, and juices.
